messages.content: How many heads can I get after tossing 3 coins?

message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, each coin can land either heads (H) or tails (T).  
Because there are three independent coins, the total number of possible outcomes is \(2^3 = 8\).

The **number of heads** you can obtain ranges from:

| Heads | Example outcome(s) |
|-------|--------------------|
| 0     | T T T              |
| 1     | H T T, T H T, T T H |
| 2     | H H T, H T H, T H H |
| 3     | H H H              |

So after tossing three coins, you can get **0, 1, 2, or 3 heads**.
